source.name: Urdu Wikisource: کوئی امید بر نہیں آتی (translation and commentary written for this app)
source.author: Mirza Ghalib

intro: One of Mirza Ghalib's best-known ghazals, about hopelessness, sleepless nights and a heart too sad even to laugh at itself. These are the opening five of its ten couplets.

sentences.english: no way out can be seen.

explanation.urdu: شاعر کہتا ہے کہ میری کوئی امید پوری نہیں ہوتی۔ مشکل سے نکلنے کا کوئی راستہ بھی دکھائی نہیں دیتا۔
explanation.english: The poet says none of his hopes come true, and he can see no way out of his trouble.

sentences.urdu: موت کا ایک دن معین ہے
sentences.english: The day of death is fixed;

sentences.urdu: نیند کیوں رات بھر نہیں آتی؟
sentences.english: why, then, does sleep not come all night long?

explanation.urdu: موت کا دن تو پہلے سے طے ہے، اس لیے اس کی فکر بےکار ہے۔ پھر بھی پریشانی اتنی ہے کہ رات بھر نیند نہیں آتی۔
explanation.english: The day of death is already decided, so worrying about it is useless. Yet his anxiety is so great that he cannot sleep all night.

sentences.urdu: آگے آتی تھی حال دل پہ ہنسی
sentences.english: Once I used to laugh at the state of my heart;

sentences.urdu: اب کسی بات پر نہیں آتی
sentences.english: now nothing at all makes me laugh.

explanation.urdu: پہلے شاعر اپنے دکھی دل کے حال پر ہنس لیتا تھا۔ اب غم اتنا بڑھ گیا ہے کہ کسی بات پر بھی ہنسی نہیں آتی۔
explanation.english: Earlier the poet could laugh at the sorry state of his heart. Now his grief has grown so much that nothing makes him laugh.

sentences.urdu: جانتا ہوں ثوابِ طاعت و زہد
sentences.english: I know the reward of obedience and piety,
but my heart is not drawn that way.

explanation.urdu: شاعر جانتا ہے کہ عبادت اور پرہیزگاری کا بڑا ثواب ہے۔ مگر اس کا دل ان کاموں کی طرف نہیں جاتا۔
explanation.english: The poet knows that worship and self-denial bring great reward, but his heart is not inclined towards them.

sentences.urdu: ہے کچھ ایسی ہی بات جو چپ ہوں
sentences.english: There is some reason of this kind that I am silent;

sentences.urdu: ورنہ کیا بات کر نہیں آتی
sentences.english: otherwise, is it that I don't know how to talk?

explanation.urdu: شاعر کہتا ہے کہ میری خاموشی کی کوئی خاص وجہ ہے۔ ایسا نہیں کہ مجھے بات کرنا نہیں آتا۔
explanation.english: The poet says there is a particular reason for his silence; it is not that he does not know how to speak.

آتی: comes (f.); “bar aati” = is fulfilled, “nazar aati” = is seen, “baat kar(ni) aati” = know how to talk
حال: state; condition (“haal-e-dil” = state of the heart)
بات: thing; matter; talk (“baat karna” = to talk)
پر: on, at (“kisi baat par” = at anything) / but (“par” = magar)
طبعیت: temperament; inclination (spelled so on the source; standard spelling طبیعت)
جو: that; because of which (“jo chup hoon” = that I am silent)
کیا: what; (question marker: “kya … nahin aati?” = is it that … not?)
کر: do (older idiom: “baat kar nahin aati” = don’t know how to talk)

questions.urdu: شاعر کے مطابق موت کا دن…
questions.english: According to the poet, the day of death…

options.urdu: پہلے سے طے ہے، پھر بھی اسے رات بھر نیند نہیں آتی
options.english: is already fixed, yet he cannot sleep all night

options.urdu: بہت دور ہے، اس لیے وہ آرام سے سوتا ہے
options.english: is far away, so he sleeps peacefully

questions.urdu: پہلے شاعر اپنے دل کے حال پر کیا کرتا تھا؟
questions.english: What did the poet use to do about the state of his heart?

questions.urdu: شاعر عبادت کا ثواب جانتا ہے، مگر…
questions.english: The poet knows the reward of worship, but…

options.english: he does not believe in reward

options.urdu: اس کا دل اس طرف نہیں جاتا
options.english: his heart is not drawn to it
he does not know how to talk

options.urdu: اس کی کوئی خاص وجہ ہے
